values.text: Carbon-A loci whose CDS overlaps no reference protein-coding CDS (pseudo=true excluded) on the same strand; GenBank->RefSeq names through assembly-report rows with relationship '='; without a reference every locus is a candidate

rule: 1 tier 5 with a retrocopy signature or a paralog hit: paralog-discriminating RT-PCR
2 tier 5 without a paralog hit: long-read cDNA sequencing across the locus
3 >= 2 CDS segments: RT-PCR across the first predicted splice junction
4 one CDS segment, protein < 100 aa: ribosome profiling
5 one CDS segment, protein >= 100 aa: long-read cDNA sequencing
5 AGAINST-strong: locus class is pseudogene, or the retrocopy signature fired (overrides FOR)
1 FOR-strong: Swiss-Prot homolog and >= 1 Pfam domain
2 FOR: Swiss-Prot homolog or >= 1 Pfam domain
4 AGAINST-weak: any ORF flag and no FOR evidence
order within a tier: distinct Pfam families desc, best Swiss-Prot bitscore desc, locus id asc
values.status: a fixed reading aid; no ranking of these candidates has been validated
